newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Eight North Koreans defect to South - Yonhap.
newsitem.headline: Eight North Koreans defect to South - Yonhap.

text.p: Eight North Koreans defected to South Korea by boat on Wednesday, Yonhap television news reported.
It said the eight, made up of two families, sought political asylum after entering South Korean waters in the Yellow Sea.
Yonhap said the families were being escorted by a South Korean patrol vessel to the nearest port of Inchon, which lies on the west coast of the Korean peninsula.
It said they were expected to arrive at the port at around 7:00 p.m. (1000 GMT). It gave no further details.
An increasing number of North Koreans have fled the country and sought asylum in the South following several years of chronic food shortages.
